mapper.select: SELECT a1.name as actor1, a2.name as actor2, COUNT(ma1.movie_id) as collaborations FROM movie_actors ma1 JOIN movie_actors ma2 ON ma1.movie_id = ma2.movie_id JOIN actors a1 ON ma1.actor_id = a1.id JOIN actors a2 ON ma2.actor_id = a2.id WHERE a1.name < a2.name GROUP BY actor1, actor2 ORDER BY collaborations DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT d.name as director, a.name as actor, COUNT(md.movie_id) as collaborations FROM movie_directors md JOIN movie_actors ma ON md.movie_id = ma.movie_id JOIN directors d ON md.director_id = d.id JOIN actors a ON ma.actor_id = a.id GROUP BY director, actor ORDER BY collaborations DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a1.name as actor1, a2.name as actor2, SUM(m.review_num) as review_sum FROM movie_actors ma1 JOIN movie_actors ma2 ON ma1.movie_id = ma2.movie_id JOIN actors a1 ON ma1.actor_id = a1.id JOIN actors a2 ON ma2.actor_id = a2.id JOIN movies m ON ma1.movie_id = m.id WHERE a1.name < a2.name GROUP BY actor1, actor2 ORDER BY review_sum DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT a1.name as actor1, a2.name as actor2, SUM(m.review_num) as review_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) as movies FROM movie_genres mg JOIN movies m ON mg.movie_id = m.id JOIN movie_actors ma1 ON m.id = ma1.movie_id JOIN movie_actors ma2 ON m.id = ma2.movie_id JOIN actors a1 ON ma1.actor_id = a1.id JOIN actors a2 ON ma2.actor_id = a2.id WHERE mg.genre = #{genre} AND a1.name < a2.name GROUP BY actor1, actor2 ORDER BY review_sum DESC LIMIT #{limit}
